findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_image, generate_sound_effect, check_generation_status, search_stock_images, search_stock_audio, get_generation_history, upload_media, create_social_post, list_my_themes, recommend_influencers · Private data: generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, generate_3d_model, upscale_image, upscale_video, generate_depth_map, search_stock_images, upload_media · Public sink: generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, upscale_image, upscale_video, check_generation_status, search_stock_images, upload_media, create_social_post, list_my_themes, recommend_influencers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_image, generate_sound_effect, check_generation_status, search_stock_images, search_stock_audio, get_generation_history, upload_media, create_social_post, list_my_themes, recommend_influencers · Private data: generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, generate_3d_model, upscale_image, upscale_video, generate_depth_map, search_stock_images, upload_media · Public sink: generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, upscale_image, upscale_video, check_generation_status, search_stock_images, upload_media, create_social_post, list_my_themes, recommend_influencers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
